## How to Register

1. Pick a quest from [{{QUEST_LOG_LINK}}]({{QUEST_LOG_FILE}})
2. Add your name to this roster
3. Mark the quest as "In Progress"
4. Complete the quest
5. Submit your changes
6. Update your completion record
